description: How the plant-based boom briefly threatened the meat kingdom — then crashed back to earth. This timeline traces annual revenues (billions USD) for legacy meat giants Tyson and JBS against the plant-based darlings Beyond Meat and Oatly from 2006–2026. Story beats: Beyond and Oatly’s meteoric growth and IPO-era hype (2018–2021), pandemic demand spikes, margin & supply shocks, public-market re-rating and contraction (2021–2024), and the resilience & scale of legacy packers as they consolidate and invest in alternatives. Numbers reflect company filings and reported annual revenues; later years (2025–2026) are conservative estimates based on public disclosures and analyst consensus.
youtube_description: The Protein Pivot — from plant-based IPO mania to reality checks. Watch a decade of headlines collapse into 30 seconds: Beyond Meat and Oatly skyrocketed from near-zero to IPO valuations and headline-making growth in 2018–2021, only to face margin pressure, retail softness and inventory resets that sent revenues sliding. Meanwhile Tyson and JBS used scale, distribution and M&A to absorb shocks and invest in alternative proteins. Data: annual reported revenues (company filings and public reports); later years are conservative analyst-aligned estimates. If you want more deep dives like this (and source lists), hit subscribe, like, and comment which corporate fall or comeback you want next. • Want a breakdown PDF of every data point?
